risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (PSR-175 vs another PSR variant) affecting value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/serial plate and the full model text on the control panel (not cut off).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha PSR-series keyboard with unknown exact variant.

risks.risk: Not fully functional (dead keys, stuck buttons, faulty speakers, LCD issues, or intermittent sound).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, LCD display working, playing multiple keys across the keyboard, and changing sounds/controls while audio plays clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly needing repair.

risks.risk: Adapter missing or wrong/unsafe adapter (keyboard may not power correctly).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter included (label showing voltage/amp) plus a clip of it powering the keyboard.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (scratches, cracks, loose keys, damaged speaker grilles) that reduce resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: speaker grilles, keybed/keys (especially corners), and any visible cracks/scratches on the casing.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic wear (used condition).

risks.risk: LCD dead pixels or display faults not visible in the current photo.
risks.proof: Video showing the LCD during operation (menus/settings) with readable screen content.

risks.risk: Speaker/audio quality problems (crackle, low volume, distortion) not confirmed by the report.
risks.proof: Audio test clip at low and higher volume showing clean sound (no crackle) while playing.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the full model number (confirm PSR-175) from the control panel label/serial plate.
Video: power-on showing LCD, then play across the full keyboard (left to right) and demonstrate a few buttons/controls changing sounds.
Video/audio test: play notes at low and higher volume to confirm no crackle/distortion.
Photo of the included power adapter (label with voltage/amp) and a clip showing it powering the keyboard.
Close-up photos of speaker grilles, key tops, and any casing damage (cracks/loose keys).
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a Yamaha PSR-series keyboard with built-in speakers and full-size keys, so it can be priced at its worst-case used/untested scenario; however, exact PSR-175 confirmation and full functionality are not proven from the report.
